messages:
marta: Heads up — we're seeing a sharp p99 jump on hosted API region-eu around 01:15 UTC, impact across several pools. Anyone watching queues?

devon: saw it too. p95 also nudged but p99 is the painful one. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/hosted/region-eu?panel=queue_depth (link)

alisha: quick snapshot from profiler (01:16 UTC): more time in kernel aux paths and lots of tiny batches. flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/flame/27410001

shaun: kernel-selector logs show a flurry of fallback decisions: selected_kernel=aux_small_batch when seq_len <= 32 and batch<=3. suspect sampler is flushing early so batching collapses.

marta: that matches queue depth: hosted.queue.depth spiked then dropped, while request.latency.p99 rose. looks like backlog -> sampler flush -> tiny batches -> kernel mismatch -> higher per-token latency.

devon: adding some logs from one affected worker (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T01:15:23Z INFO sampler: flush reason=wait_timeout batch_size=2 max_wait_ms=5
2026-03-17T01:15:23Z INFO kernel_selector: requested_batch=2 selected_kernel=aux_small_batch latency_est=14.2ms
2026-03-17T01:15:24Z WARN kvcache: eviction_ratio=0.42 thrash=true tenant=acct-908
```

alisha: profiler shows kernel launch overhead dominates for these aux_small_batch runs. GPU utilization not saturated but kernel overhead + context switches add up.

shaun: cross-checking recent changes — sampler tweak merged yesterday (PR #4521) lowered max_wait_ms from 20->5 for low-latency workloads. That would cause frequent early flushes during bursty patterns.

marta: ops-bot, any noisy tenants flagged?

ops-bot: noisy-tenant-detector: tenant acct-908 exceeded burst quota 3x between 01:13-01:17 UTC, flagged on host pool eu-gpu-04.

devon: so likely combo: noisy tenant generates uneven arrival -> sampler flushes earlier (PR change) -> batches small -> kernel selector picks aux_small_batch which is suboptimal for 99th tail -> p99 spike. Also kvcache eviction increases due to thrash which increases priming.

shaun: I can reproduce locally with replay tool. repro steps:
```
# generate bursty traffic with short seqs
python tools/replay.py --trace traces/bursty-shortseq.json --concurrency 120 --target eu-cluster
```
When sampler max_wait_ms=5 reproduces the p99 tail; setting to 20 removes it.

alisha: mitigation idea 1: revert sampler change in region-eu canary (rollback PR #4521).

marta: mitigation idea 2: temporarily raise selector threshold so that for batch_size<=4 it still picks fast main kernel rather than aux_small_batch. That would reduce per-token overhead even for small batches.

devon: also consider quick throttle on acct-908 to stop the noisy-neighbor amplification while we patch. Ops can apply tenant temporary rate-limit.

ops-bot: applied temporary rate-limit: acct-908 -> 60rps cap at 01:26 UTC.

deploy-bot: runtime-canary eu-gpu-04: rolling back sampler-config to prev (commit a1b2c3) started at 01:30 UTC.

shaun: running load test against canary now. baseline before change: p99 ~420ms, after revert: p99 drops to ~120ms in canary.

marta: nice. action items:
- shaun: open hotfix PR to revert sampler tweak and add a flag (owner: shaun)
- devon: add kernel-selector safety guard for small-batch-case (owner: devon)
- alisha: run expanded perf regressions against cloud traces to ensure no regressions across seq_len distributions (owner: alisha)
- ops: follow up on acct-908 and contact CS if need to escalate billing throttles (owner: ops)

shaun: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4589 (hotfix revert). will request review and merge with canary first.

marta: we'll keep this thread updated. after canary verifies for 30m we'll promote to region. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devon: note for postmortem: include sampler change diff and kernel-selector logs + kvcache eviction timeline. save profiler artifacts to incident bucket: s3://incidents/2741000123/

alisha: grabbing flamegraphs + pprof dumps now, uploading to the bucket.

marta: closing loop: 02:12 UTC post-rollout p99 back to baseline in all eu pools. will file short incident summary later.

deploy-bot: rollout eu-region sampler-revert -> success (02:12 UTC).
